info.title: Nutanix Identity and Access Management APIs
info.description: Nutanix APIs for managing users, user-groups, directory services, identity providers, roles and authorization policies.

tags.name: DirectoryServices
tags.description: These APIs configure the AD or OpenLDAP directories for user authentication.  Users can create, list, fetch, update, and delete directory services.

tags.name: SAMLIdentityProviders
tags.description: These APIs configure SAML identity providers such as ADFS or OKTA for user authentication.  Users can create, list, delete, update, and fetch SAML identity providers and SAML sp-metadata.

tags.name: CertificateAuthenticationProviders
tags.description: These APIs configure the certificate-based providers for user authentication.  Users can create, list, fetch, update, and delete certificate-based authentication providers.

tags.name: LoginProviders
tags.description: These APIs list down all the configured login providers.

tags.name: Users
tags.description: These APIs configure local, SAML, LDAP, and external users. Users can:  Create, list, fetch, update, and delete users.  Create, list, and delete Bucket Access Keys.  Change and reset user passwords and change status.

tags.name: UserGroups
tags.description: These APIs configure user groups which are a collection of IAM users.  Users create, list, fetch, and delete user groups.

tags.name: Clients
tags.description: These APIs configure and manage service clients. Users can register, list, fetch, and update service clients.

tags.name: Entities
tags.description: These APIs configure and manage entities representing the resources over which permissions are defined. Users can use these APIs to list and fetch entities.

tags.name: Operations
tags.description: These APIs manage the operations that an identity can perform on a set of entities. Users can use these APIs to list and fetch operations.

tags.name: Roles
tags.description: These APIs manage and configure roles for identities. The role represents a list of operations. Users can use these APIs to create, list, fetch, update, delete, migrate, and scan migration impacts for Roles.

tags.name: AuthorizationPolicies
tags.description: These APIs configure authorization policies for identities, giving them access to perform a list of operations on certain entities.  Users can create, list, fetch, update, and delete authorization policies.

tags.name: WelcomeBanner
tags.description: These APIs configure and manage the banner shown during Login screen.
